title: Telling the time: ～じ and ～ふん
pattern: いま ＋ (ごぜん / ごご) ＋ number + じ ＋ (number + ふん / はん) ＋ です
meaning_en: States the time; いま なんじ です か asks it.
explanation: Hours are a number plus じ: いちじ, にじ, さんじ ... but three are irregular: よじ (4), しちじ (7), くじ (9). 10, 11 and 12 are じゅうじ, じゅういちじ, じゅうにじ.
Add はん for "half past" and number + ふん / ぷん for minutes: さんじ ごふん is 3:05. Some minutes are irregular, such as じゅっぷん (10 minutes).
ごぜん means a.m. and ごご means p.m., and both go before the hour. To ask the time say いま なんじ です か.
structure_notes: いま (ごぜん/ごご) + hour + (minutes / はん) + です.
common_mistakes: Saying よんじ instead of よじ.
Saying ななじ instead of しちじ.
Putting the minutes before the hour.
